name: sarpulse
description: SARPulse: see and hear Earth's surface move with NASA-ISRO NISAR radar. NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 - Dancing with the SARs.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-math.mjs && node scripts/vendor.mjs && next dev
scripts.build: node scripts/build-math.mjs && node scripts/vendor.mjs && next build && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:math && npm run build
scripts.test:py: uv run --with pytest --with numpy pytest -q pipeline/tests
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15 deploy --only hosting
scripts.ship: npm run build && node scripts/capture-frames.mjs && npm run deploy

author: MCP Lead (Adrian Gomez, Jose Unanue)
